chunks: And they narrated from Hanan, who said:

I was sitting with Suwayd ibn Ghafalah when a man came to him and asked him about a daughter, a wife, and freed slaves. He said: I will inform you concerning it with the judgment of Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام: he assigned half to the daughter and one-eighth to the wife, and returned what remained to the daughter, and he gave nothing to the freed slaves.

key_terms.الِابْنَةِ: the daughter as a legal heir in inheritance
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the wife as a legal heir in inheritance
key_terms.الْمَوَالِيَ: freed slaves or clients considered in inheritance discussions
key_terms.بِقَضَاءِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَل: the legal judgment transmitted from Imam Ali عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام rule on the inheritance of a daughter, a wife, and mawali?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling on inheritance attributed to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام concerning a deceased person survived by a daughter, a wife, and mawali. The daughter receives one-half, the wife receives one-eighth, and the remainder is returned to the daughter, while the mawali receive nothing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5655 - They narrated from Hanan who said:

I was sitting with Suwayd ibn Ghafalah when a man came to him and asked about the inheritance of a daughter, a wife, and freed slaves.
Suwayd said: "I will inform you of the ruling of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) regarding this matter. Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) allocated half of the inheritance to the daughter and one-eighth to the wife, and Imam (as) returned what remained to the daughter, giving nothing to the freed slaves."
